howItWorks.title: From story to song in 3 steps
howItWorks.description: No singing or songwriting skills needed. Just tell us how you feel.

tell.title: Tell us about them
tell.body: Answer 7 short questions: who they are, the occasion, your memories together, and the message you want to share.

create.title: We create the song
create.body: We write lyrics from your story, then arrange and sing them in the genre, voice, and mood you pick.

listen.title: Listen & share
listen.body: Play the free preview up to the first chorus. Love it? Unlock the full song and send it as a gift.

samples.title: Listen to songs we’ve made
samples.description: Every song is written from a different story. Press play and feel it for yourself.

features.title: A truly personal gift
features.description: Not an off-the-shelf song. Every song is made from scratch, based on your story.

lyrics.title: Lyrics from your memories
lyrics.body: Nicknames, special moments, and your message woven into lyrics that fit only them.

genres.title: Plenty of genres
genres.body: Pop, Ballad, Acoustic, R&B, Jazz, Dangdut, Keroncong, even lullabies.

voice.title: Choose the singer’s voice
voice.body: Male or female vocals — or let us surprise you.

mood.title: Set the mood
mood.body: Romantic, cheerful, moving, funny, or upbeat — match it to the moment.

language.title: Indonesian & English
language.body: Write the lyrics in the language closest to both your hearts.

fast.title: Fast and easy
fast.body: Fill in the questionnaire in a few minutes and hear the preview right away, no account needed.

account.q: Do I need to sign up first?
account.a: No. You can fill in the questionnaire and listen to the preview without an account. You only need one to save your song and unlock the full version.

duration.a: Usually just a few minutes after you send your answers. The page shows your song automatically as soon as it’s ready.

dislike.q: What if I don’t love the result?
dislike.a: You can regenerate the song from the same answers to get different lyrics and a different arrangement.

previewVsFull.q: What’s the difference between the preview and the full song?
previewVsFull.a: The preview plays from the start of the song to the end of the first chorus. The full song includes everything, plus the complete lyrics, ready to download and share.

languages.a: Right now, lyrics can be written in Indonesian and English.

finalCta.title: Make them smile with a song that’s theirs alone
finalCta.body: Start now — the preview is free, no sign-up needed.

legal.title: Terms & Conditions
legal.prevailing: This English version is provided for convenience. If it differs from the Indonesian version, the Indonesian version prevails.

penerimaan.title: Acceptance of Terms
body: By accessing or using Cerita Lagu (the "Service"), you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.
We may update these terms at any time. The latest version is always available on this page, and using the Service after a change means you accept that version.

layanan.title: About the Service
body: Cerita Lagu creates personal songs based on the questionnaire answers you provide. Lyrics, arrangements, and vocals are generated with the help of artificial intelligence (AI).
Because songs are made by AI, every result can differ and may not always match your expectations. We do not guarantee that name pronunciation, rhymes, or musical style will be exactly as you imagine.

akun.title: Accounts & Use Without an Account
body: You can fill in the questionnaire and listen to the preview without creating an account. To save songs and unlock the full version, you need to sign in with a valid email address.
You are responsible for keeping access to your account and email confidential, and for all activity that takes place through your account.
Songs created without an account are stored on the device/browser you use. If they are not claimed to an account within 30 days, that data and those songs may be deleted automatically.

konten-pengguna.title: Questionnaire Content
body: You confirm that the stories, names, and information you enter are yours or that you have the right to use them, and that they do not infringe anyone else’s rights.

You may not enter content that contains hate speech, discrimination based on ethnicity, religion, race, or group (SARA), pornography, violence, defamation, harassment, or anything else that violates the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.
We may refuse, stop creating, or delete songs that violate these terms, without any obligation to refund.

preview.title: Preview & Regenerate
body: Every song comes with a free preview of its opening section. Listen to the preview before buying the full song.
You can regenerate a song from the same answers within the limit shown on the song page. Daily song creation may also be limited to prevent abuse.

harga.title: Pricing & Payment
body: The price of the full song is shown in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) before you pay, including any discount from a valid voucher. Payment is made once per song.
Payments are processed by our payment gateway partner (DOKU). We do not store your card or bank account details.
Orders that are not paid within the set time limit expire automatically. You can check out again at any time.
Vouchers are valid only under their own terms, validity period, and quota, cannot be exchanged for cash, and may be cancelled if misuse is suspected.

pengiriman.title: Delivery of Digital Products
body: The full song is a digital product. Once payment is confirmed, the song is unlocked immediately on the song page and can be played and downloaded through your account.

pengembalian-dana.title: Cancellations & Refunds
body: Because a preview is available before purchase and the song is delivered instantly, completed purchases cannot be cancelled or refunded for reasons of taste or a change of mind.

A refund may be given if: (a) you were charged twice for the same song; (b) payment succeeded but the song did not unlock and we cannot fix it; or (c) the song file is corrupted and we cannot provide a replacement.

Submit your request within 7 days of payment, including your account email and proof of payment. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method, subject to the payment provider’s processing time.

hak-penggunaan.title: Song Usage Rights
body: After buying the full song, you may use it for personal, non-commercial purposes — for example, playing it at a family event, giving it as a gift, or sharing it on your personal social media.
Commercial use, such as reselling the song, registering it with music distribution or streaming services, or using it in paid advertising, is not allowed without our written consent.
We may use songs and lyrics anonymously (without names or personal data) to improve the quality of the Service. We will not feature your song as a public sample without your permission.

larangan.title: Prohibited Use
body: You may not try to access full songs without paying, disrupt or overload the system, use bots or automated scripts, or abuse quotas, vouchers, or security vulnerabilities of the Service.
Violations may result in restricted access, account deactivation, and cancellation of purchases.

privasi.title: Personal Data
body: We process questionnaire answers, email addresses, and technical data only as needed to create songs, run accounts, process payments, and prevent abuse. We do not sell your personal data to anyone.
You can request deletion of your account and song data by contacting us.

tanggung-jawab.title: Limitation of Liability
body: The Service is provided "as is". We work to keep the Service available, but we do not guarantee that it will be free of interruptions or errors.
To the extent permitted by law, our liability for any claim relating to a song is limited to the amount you paid for that song.

hukum.title: Governing Law
body: These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any dispute will first be resolved through good-faith discussion (musyawarah).

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: Questions about these terms, payments, or refunds? Send us a message through the <link>contact page</link> or email <mail>{email}</mail>.
